build_rules.text: Every unit runs the gate commands in docs/binding.md before commit; hooks are never bypassed.

phases.title: Environment and toolchain
phases.phase_intro: Optional prose that applies to every step in this phase.

steps.title: Repo skeleton and gate commands
steps.body_md:
- **Context:** hand-authored prose, rendered verbatim; rationale, dated corrections, evidence.
- **Do:** create the skeleton; wire the gate commands from docs/binding.md into the pre-commit hook.
- **Verify:** the hook runs and exits 0 on a clean tree.

steps.title: Pinned-target compatibility and regression suite
steps.body_md: - **Do:** run the suite on the pinned runtime named in docs/binding.md; add one regression test per prior real finding.
